title: Kayan aikin tsabta, kwanakin gaskiya da farashin da ke biya
course_title: Kula da Gashi & Salon Sauƙaƙe: Ayyukan Sabis na Salon

say: Kayan aikin tsabta, kwanakin gaskiya, da farashin da ke biya.
Wannan shi ne bidiyon don module 4 na Kula da gashi da Salon Sauƙi.

Kwararren mai salo na iya rasa abokan ciniki har yanzu. Combs, shirye-shiryen bidiyo da tawul suna motsawa daga kai zuwa kai, kuma ba tare da aikin yau da kullun ba suna ɗauke da lace, cututtukan fungal da ƙwayoyin cuta.

say: Kwanaki suna tafiya a makare lokacin da ake ƙididdige lokutan maimakon aunawa.

say: Kuma farashin da aka kwafi daga salon da ke ƙasa hanya bazai rufe gashin kanku, samfuran, man fetur da lokaci ba. Wannan tsarin yana gyara duka ukun.

say: Koyaushe tsaftace farko. Sabulu da ruwa suna cire gashi da gel. Maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta da aka zuba a kan datti yana yin kadan.

panel.heading: Hadawa 2 lita na 0.1% Bleach
items: Tsaftace da sabulu da ruwa da farko
5% Bleach: 40 ml na 2,000 ml gabaɗaya
Ruwa: 2,000 debe 40 = 1,960 ml
Hannun hannu, buɗe taga, yiwa alama da kwanan wata

say: Misali, Zainab a Jos tana son lita 2 na maganin bleach 0.1%. Ƙa'idar ita ce sau 0.1 na jimlar milliliters, an raba shi da kashi a kan lakabin. Tare da 5% bleach, wato 40 ml na bleach.

say: Sauran ruwa: 1,960 ml. Wato kashi 1 na bleach zuwa ruwa kashi 49. Idan lakabin ku yana nuna ƙarfin daban, sake ƙididdigewa.

say: Mix shi da safar hannu na roba, a cikin wuri mai iska, nesa da yara da abinci. Alama shi kar ya sha, tare da kwanan wata, kuma sanya shi sabo kowace ranar aiki.
Kada a taɓa haɗa bleach tare da ammonia ko wasu masu tsaftacewa, saboda suna iya sakin iskar gas mai haɗari.

say: Bayan kowane abokin ciniki guda ɗaya, share gashin a cikin kwandon da aka rufe, sa'an nan kuma sanya combs da shirye-shiryen da aka yi amfani da su kai tsaye cikin kwandon da aka yi amfani da su. Kar a sake komawa kan tire.

Fresh tawul da cape na gaba abokin ciniki

say: A wanke su a cikin ruwan sabulu, goge tsakanin hakora, jiƙa kayan aikin filastik a cikin maganin bleach, sannan a wanke kuma a bushe. Bleach yana lalata ƙarfe, don haka wanke kayan aikin ƙarfe da sabulu maimakon.

say: Misali, Ifeoma a Asaba tana farashin ciyarwar masara 8 tare da kari. Ta fara gina farashin ne daga kuɗin kanta.
Gashi, gel, kayan wanke-wanke, safar hannu da ɗigon wuya sun zo kusan naira 4,930.
Log ɗin ta yana nuna 3.5 hours. Akan kudirinta na naira 1,500 a awa daya, wato naira 5,250 kenan.
Sama da sama da Naira 30,000 na wata-wata sama da ayyuka 60 na ba da Naira 500 ga kowane hidima.
Jimlar farashi: Naira 10,680. Ta kara kashi 20% na ribar riba sannan ta koma naira 13,000. Sai kawai ta kwatanta da salon da ke kusa.
Nemi ajiya lokacin da ka sayi gashi ga abokin ciniki. Kusan kashi 30 cikin 100 na Naira 13,000 3,900 ne, don haka Ifeoma ta nemi Naira 4,000 wanda ya rufe gashin.

panel.heading: Adadin ajiya da amintaccen biyan kuɗi

cards.d: Kimanin kashi 30% lokacin siyan gashi. A tsarin naira 13,000 ta nemi naira 4,000.

cards.t: Tabbatar a cikin app ɗin ku
cards.d: Bude app na bankin ku kuma duba kuɗin a ma'auni. Hoton hoto ko SMS ba hujja ba ce.
Idan farashin gashi ya tashi ko salon ya ɗauki tsayi, sabunta menu kuma gaya wa abokan ciniki na yau da kullun da farko.

say: Faɗakarwar canja wurin karya da hotunan kariyar kwamfuta dabara ce ta gama gari. Kafin ta tafi, buɗe app ɗin bankin ku kuma tabbatar da cewa kuɗin yana cikin ma'aunin ku.

say: Don tunawa. Tsaftace da farko, sannan ka lalata, kuma kada a haɗa bleach da sauran masu tsaftacewa. Auna lokutan ku kuma yi lissafin sake saiti. Gina farashi daga farashin ku, sannan ƙara riba. Kuma tabbatar da kowane biyan kuɗi a cikin app ɗin ku.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Da farko a tsaftace da sabulu, sannan a kashe
Kada a taɓa haɗa bleach da sauran masu tsaftacewa
Lokaci kowane mataki; littafin sake saitin kuma
Farashin = kayan + lokaci + riba + riba
Tabbatar da kowane canja wuri a cikin app ɗin ku

say: Yanzu yi aiki. Yi lakabin kwantena masu tsabta da amfani da kuma lokacin sake saitin ku. Fara log log ɗin ku kuma tsara rana ta gaske. Sannan ku kashe sabis uku kuma ku tsara menu na farashin shafi ɗaya.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Saita kwantena masu tsabta da amfani; lokacin sake saitin ku
Fara log log kuma shirya ranar yin booking 3
Kudin sabis uku kuma tsara menu na farashin ku
